import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path = Path('results/expansion/intermittent_resume_plan.json')
command = ['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'nim', '.venv/bin/python', '-u',
           'scripts/expand_nim.py', '--models', 'nvidia/nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b',
           'meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct', '--protocol-file', 'protocol-intermittent-resume.json']
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'one missing-only resume of already responsive models after adding bounded NIM 404 backoff'}, 'NIM immutable deployment revision not exposed'),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'waiting_for_current_batches',
          'command': command,
          'evidence': ['results/expansion/bolt_partial_failure.json',
                       'results/expansion/protocol-bolt-resume.json',
                       'results/expansion/protocol-supplement.json'],
          'rule': 'Preserve all valid episodes and cached responses; no decoder, prompt, game or seed change. At most three attempts per request, including intermittent NIM 404s. No partial-cohort scoring or test-based tuning.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
for name in ('bolt_resume_plan.json', 'additional_followup_plan.json'):
    while json.loads((Path('results/expansion') / name).read_text())['status'] != 'finished':
        time.sleep(10)
prefixes = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in Path('results/expansion/raw').rglob('*.jsonl')
            if p.name in ('nvidia_nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b.jsonl',
                          'meta_llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct__text-only_.jsonl')}
record.update(status='acquiring_slot_then_running',
              existing_prefixes={str(p): {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': file_sha256(p)}
                                 for p, data in prefixes.items()})
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
result = subprocess.run(command)
assert all(p.read_bytes().startswith(data) for p, data in prefixes.items())
record.update(status='finished', exit_code=result.returncode, existing_prefixes_preserved=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
rule: Preserve all valid episodes and cached responses; no decoder, prompt, game or seed change. At most three attempts per request, including intermittent NIM 404s. No partial-cohort scoring or test-based tuning.
